```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = "asis")
source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
report_start("preprocess")

host_names <- names(ctx$features$hosts)
fastp_dir <- p("results", "preprocess", "fastp")
fastp_json <- setNames(file.path(fastp_dir, paste0(libraries(), "_fastp.json")), libraries())
fastp_json <- fastp_json[file.exists(fastp_json)]
fastp <- map(fastp_json, jsonlite::fromJSON)

fastp_table <- map_dfr(names(fastp), function(library) {
  j <- fastp[[library]]
  before <- j$summary$before_filtering
  after <- j$summary$after_filtering
  filtered <- j$filtering_result
  tibble(
    library = library,
    raw_reads = before$total_reads,
    raw_bases = before$total_bases,
    kept_reads = after$total_reads,
    kept_bases = after$total_bases,
    low_quality_reads = filtered$low_quality_reads %||% 0,
    too_many_n_reads = filtered$too_many_N_reads %||% 0,
    too_short_reads = filtered$too_short_reads %||% 0,
    too_long_reads = filtered$too_long_reads %||% 0,
    adapter_trimmed_reads = j$adapter_cutting$adapter_trimmed_reads %||% NA_real_,
    adapter_trimmed_bases = j$adapter_cutting$adapter_trimmed_bases %||% NA_real_,
    q20_before = 100 * before$q20_rate,
    q30_before = 100 * before$q30_rate,
    q20_after = 100 * after$q20_rate,
    q30_after = 100 * after$q30_rate,
    gc_before = 100 * before$gc_content,
    gc_after = 100 * after$gc_content,
    length_before = before$read1_mean_length,
    length_after = after$read1_mean_length,
    duplication_pct = 100 * (j$duplication$rate %||% NA_real_),
    insert_peak = j$insert_size$peak %||% NA_real_
  )
})

# Pairs at each step. A pair is removed if at least one of its reads maps, since the rule keeps pairs
# with both reads unmapped (samtools view -f 12). "reads mapped and paired" counts reads with both
# mates mapped, so these reads make up half as many pairs.
host_table <- map_dfr(host_names, function(host) {
  map_dfr(libraries(), function(library) {
    file <- p("results", "preprocess", "bowtie2", host, paste0(library, ".stats.txt"))
    if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
    stats <- read_samstats(file)
    both <- stats[["reads mapped and paired"]]
    tibble(
      host = host,
      library = library,
      reads_in = stats[["raw total sequences"]],
      reads_mapped = stats[["reads mapped"]],
      pairs_in = reads_in / 2,
      pairs_removed = reads_mapped - both / 2,
      pairs_out = pairs_in - pairs_removed,
      mapped_pct = 100 * reads_mapped / reads_in
    )
  })
})

fates <- if (nrow(fastp_table) > 0) {
  fates <- fastp_table %>% transmute(library, raw_pairs = raw_reads / 2, after_fastp = kept_reads / 2)
  if (nrow(host_table) > 0) {
    removed <- host_table %>%
      select(library, host, pairs_removed) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = host, values_from = pairs_removed, names_prefix = "removed_")
    last <- host_table %>%
      mutate(position = match(host, host_names)) %>%
      group_by(library) %>%
      slice_max(position, n = 1) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      transmute(library, clean_pairs = pairs_out)
    fates <- fates %>% left_join(removed, by = "library") %>% left_join(last, by = "library")
  } else {
    fates$clean_pairs <- fates$after_fastp
  }
  mutate(fates, kept_pct = 100 * clean_pairs / raw_pairs)
} else {
  tibble()
}
```

```{r brief}
section("Results in brief", {
  if (nrow(fates) == 0) {
    no_output("fastp", "results/preprocess/fastp/")
  } else {
    para(
      "From **", fmt_int(sum(fates$raw_pairs)), " raw read pairs**, preprocessing kept **", fmt_int(sum(fates$clean_pairs, na.rm = TRUE)),
      " clean pairs** (", fmt_pct(100 * sum(fates$clean_pairs, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(fates$raw_pairs)), "). Per library, between ",
      fmt_pct(min(fates$kept_pct, na.rm = TRUE)), " and ", fmt_pct(max(fates$kept_pct, na.rm = TRUE)), " were kept, and a mean of ",
      fmt_int(mean(fates$clean_pairs, na.rm = TRUE)), " pairs per library remains for the next modules."
    )
    para(
      "fastp raised the share of bases of at least Q30 from ", fmt_pct(mean(fastp_table$q30_before)), " to ",
      fmt_pct(mean(fastp_table$q30_after)), ", and trimmed adapter from ", fmt_pct(100 * sum(fastp_table$adapter_trimmed_reads, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(fastp_table$raw_reads)),
      " of the reads."
    )
    if (nrow(host_table) > 0) {
      by_host <- host_table %>%
        group_by(host) %>%
        summarise(pct = 100 * sum(reads_mapped) / sum(reads_in), .groups = "drop")
      para("Reads mapping to the hosts: ", paste0(by_host$host, " ", fmt_pct(by_host$pct, 2), collapse = ", "), ".")
    }
    low <- filter(fates, kept_pct < 0.8 * median(kept_pct, na.rm = TRUE))
    if (nrow(low) > 0) {
      para("**Check these libraries:** ", paste0("`", low$library, "`", collapse = ", "), " lost clearly more reads than the others.")
    }
  }
})
```

```{r fates}
section("What happened to the reads", {
  if (nrow(fates) > 0) {
    display <- fates %>% transmute(Library = library, `Raw pairs` = fmt_int(raw_pairs), `After fastp` = fmt_int(after_fastp))
    for (host in host_names) {
      column <- paste0("removed_", host)
      if (column %in% names(fates)) display[[paste0("Removed: ", host)]] <- fmt_int(fates[[column]])
    }
    display$`Clean pairs` <- fmt_int(fates$clean_pairs)
    display$Kept <- fmt_pct(fates$kept_pct)
    show_table(display, "Read pairs after each step of preprocessing", "read_pairs_per_step", export = fates, max_rows = 60)

    stacked <- fastp_table %>%
      transmute(library, `Low quality` = low_quality_reads, `Too many N` = too_many_n_reads,
                `Too short` = too_short_reads + too_long_reads, raw_reads)
    long <- stacked %>%
      pivot_longer(c(`Low quality`, `Too many N`, `Too short`), names_to = "fate", values_to = "reads")
    if (nrow(host_table) > 0) {
      long <- bind_rows(long, host_table %>%
        transmute(library, fate = paste0("Host: ", host), reads = 2 * pairs_removed,
                  raw_reads = fastp_table$raw_reads[match(library, fastp_table$library)]))
    }
    long <- bind_rows(long, fates %>%
      transmute(library, fate = "Clean", reads = 2 * clean_pairs, raw_reads = raw_pairs * 2))
    long <- long %>%
      group_by(library) %>%
      mutate(other = 0) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(share = 100 * reads / raw_reads, library = factor(library, levels = rev(libraries())))
    levels_fate <- c("Clean", setdiff(unique(long$fate), "Clean"))
    long$fate <- factor(long$fate, levels = rev(levels_fate))
    write_tsv(long, file.path(ctx$tables, "read_fates.tsv"))
    colours <- setNames(c("#009E73", "#D55E00", "#E69F00", "#F0E442", "#CC79A7", "#56B4E9", "#0072B2", "#999999")[seq_along(levels_fate)], levels_fate)
    show_figure(
      ggplot(long, aes(share, library, fill = fate)) +
        geom_col() +
        scale_fill_manual(values = colours, name = NULL, guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
        labs(x = "Share of raw reads (%)", y = NULL) +
        theme_report() +
        library_axis(n_distinct(long$library)),
      "read_fates",
      "What happened to the raw reads of each library. The rest to 100% are reads that fastp left without a partner.",
      height = rows_height(n_distinct(long$library))
    )
  }
})
```

```{r fastp}
section("Trimming and filtering (fastp)", {
  if (nrow(fastp_table) == 0) {
    no_output("fastp", "results/preprocess/fastp/")
  } else {
    para("The HTML reports of fastp are in `results/preprocess/fastp/*_fastp.html`.")
    show_table(
      fastp_table %>% transmute(
        Library = library,
        `Raw reads` = fmt_int(raw_reads),
        `Kept reads` = fmt_int(kept_reads),
        `Kept bases` = fmt_bp(kept_bases),
        `Low quality` = fmt_int(low_quality_reads),
        `Too many N` = fmt_int(too_many_n_reads),
        `Too short` = fmt_int(too_short_reads),
        `Adapter trimmed` = fmt_pct(100 * adapter_trimmed_reads / raw_reads)
      ),
      "Reads and bases that fastp kept, and why it removed the others",
      "fastp_filtering",
      export = fastp_table,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    show_table(
      fastp_table %>% transmute(
        Library = library,
        `Q20 before` = fmt_pct(q20_before), `Q20 after` = fmt_pct(q20_after),
        `Q30 before` = fmt_pct(q30_before), `Q30 after` = fmt_pct(q30_after),
        `GC before` = fmt_pct(gc_before), `GC after` = fmt_pct(gc_after),
        `Length before` = fmt_int(length_before), `Length after` = fmt_int(length_after),
        Duplicates = fmt_pct(duplication_pct, 2),
        `Insert peak` = fmt_int(insert_peak)
      ),
      "Quality before and after fastp. Q20 and Q30 are shares of bases, the length is the mean of the forward reads, and Duplicates is fastp's estimate",
      "fastp_quality",
      export = fastp_table %>% select(library, q20_before:insert_peak),
      max_rows = 60
    )
    adapters <- map_dfr(names(fastp), function(library) {
      cutting <- fastp[[library]]$adapter_cutting
      if (is.null(cutting)) return(NULL)
      tibble(
        library = library,
        forward_adapter = cutting$read1_adapter_sequence %||% NA_character_,
        reverse_adapter = cutting$read2_adapter_sequence %||% NA_character_,
        trimmed_reads = cutting$adapter_trimmed_reads %||% NA_real_,
        trimmed_bases = cutting$adapter_trimmed_bases %||% NA_real_
      )
    })
    if (nrow(adapters) > 0) {
      show_table(
        adapters %>% transmute(
          Library = library, `Forward adapter` = forward_adapter, `Reverse adapter` = reverse_adapter,
          `Trimmed reads` = fmt_int(trimmed_reads), `Trimmed bases` = fmt_int(trimmed_bases)
        ),
        "Adapter sequences that fastp used, and how much it trimmed",
        "adapter_trimming",
        export = adapters,
        max_rows = 60
      )
      counts <- map_dfr(names(fastp), function(library) {
        one <- function(name, read) {
          found <- unlist(fastp[[library]]$adapter_cutting[[name]])
          if (length(found) == 0) return(NULL)
          tibble(library = library, read = read, sequence = names(found), count = as.numeric(found))
        }
        bind_rows(one("read1_adapter_counts", "Forward reads"), one("read2_adapter_counts", "Reverse reads"))
      })
      if (nrow(counts) > 0) {
        write_tsv(counts, file.path(ctx$tables, "adapter_counts.tsv"))
        kept <- counts %>%
          mutate(sequence = substr(sequence, 1, 30), kind = top_n_other(sequence, count, n = 6)) %>%
          group_by(library, read, kind) %>%
          summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
          mutate(library = factor(library, levels = rev(libraries())))
        show_figure(
          ggplot(kept, aes(count, library, fill = kind)) +
            geom_col() +
            scale_fill_manual(values = category_colours(unique(kept$kind)), name = NULL, guide = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
            facet_wrap(~read) +
            labs(x = "Reads with this sequence trimmed", y = NULL) +
            theme_report() +
            library_axis(n_distinct(kept$library)),
          "adapter_counts",
          "The sequences that fastp trimmed most often, per library. Others are all remaining sequences.",
          height = rows_height(n_distinct(kept$library), 0.2, 1.8)
        )
      }
    }
    q30 <- fastp_table %>%
      mutate(library = factor(library, levels = rev(library))) %>%
      select(library, Before = q30_before, After = q30_after) %>%
      pivot_longer(-library)
    show_figure(
      ggplot(q30, aes(value, library, colour = name)) +
        geom_line(aes(group = library), colour = "grey75") +
        geom_point(size = 1.8) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = c(Before = PALETTE[[2]], After = PALETTE[[1]]), name = NULL) +
        labs(x = "Bases of at least Q30 (%)", y = NULL) +
        theme_report() +
        library_axis(nrow(fastp_table)),
      "q30_before_after",
      "Share of bases of at least Q30, before and after fastp.",
      height = rows_height(nrow(fastp_table))
    )
    curves <- map_dfr(names(fastp), function(library) {
      j <- fastp[[library]]
      one <- function(part, read, stage) {
        mean_q <- j[[part]]$quality_curves$mean
        tibble(library = library, read = read, stage = stage, position = seq_along(mean_q), quality = mean_q)
      }
      bind_rows(
        one("read1_before_filtering", "Forward reads", "Before"),
        one("read1_after_filtering", "Forward reads", "After"),
        one("read2_before_filtering", "Reverse reads", "Before"),
        one("read2_after_filtering", "Reverse reads", "After")
      )
    })
    write_tsv(curves, file.path(ctx$tables, "quality_before_after.tsv"))
    show_figure(
      ggplot(curves, aes(position, quality, colour = stage, group = interaction(library, stage))) +
        geom_line(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = c(Before = PALETTE[[2]], After = PALETTE[[1]]), name = NULL) +
        facet_wrap(~read) +
        labs(x = "Position in read (bp)", y = "Mean base quality (Phred)") +
        theme_report(),
      "quality_before_after",
      "Mean base quality along the reads before and after fastp, one line per library."
    )
    inserts <- map_dfr(names(fastp), function(library) {
      histogram <- fastp[[library]]$insert_size$histogram
      if (is.null(histogram) || length(histogram) == 0) return(NULL)
      tibble(library = library, insert = seq_along(histogram) - 1, share = 100 * histogram / sum(histogram))
    })
    if (nrow(inserts) > 0) {
      write_tsv(inserts, file.path(ctx$tables, "insert_sizes.tsv"))
      show_figure(
        ggplot(filter(inserts, insert > 0), aes(insert, share, group = library)) +
          geom_line(colour = PALETTE[[3]], alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3) +
          labs(x = "Insert size (bp)", y = "Read pairs (%)") +
          theme_report(),
        "insert_sizes",
        "Insert sizes that fastp estimated from overlapping read pairs, one line per library. fastp can't measure inserts longer than the two reads together, and counts those at the right end.",
        height = 2.8
      )
    }
  }
})
```

```{r hosts}
section("Host decontamination", {
  if (length(host_names) == 0) {
    para("No hosts are configured, so the reads pass from fastp straight to the next modules.")
  } else if (nrow(host_table) == 0) {
    no_output("the host mapping", "results/preprocess/bowtie2/")
  } else {
    para("Reads are mapped to one host after the other. Pairs with both reads unmapped go on to the next host, and the rest are removed.")
    show_table(
      host_table %>% transmute(
        Host = host, Library = library, `Pairs in` = fmt_int(pairs_in), `Reads mapped` = fmt_int(reads_mapped),
        Mapped = fmt_pct(mapped_pct, 2), `Pairs removed` = fmt_int(pairs_removed), `Pairs out` = fmt_int(pairs_out)
      ),
      "Reads per host and library",
      "host_mapping",
      export = host_table,
      max_rows = 60
    )
    show_figure(
      host_table %>%
        mutate(library = factor(library, levels = rev(libraries()))) %>%
        ggplot(aes(mapped_pct, library)) +
        geom_col(fill = PALETTE[[6]]) +
        facet_wrap(~host, scales = "free_x") +
        labs(x = "Reads mapped to the host (%)", y = NULL) +
        theme_report() +
        library_axis(n_distinct(host_table$library)),
      "host_mapping",
      "Share of reads that mapped to each host, in each library.",
      height = rows_height(n_distinct(host_table$library))
    )
    chromosome_counts <- map_dfr(host_names, function(host) {
      map_dfr(libraries(), function(library) {
        file <- p("results", "preprocess", "quantification", host, paste0(library, ".chr_alignment_counts.tsv"))
        if (!file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
        table <- read.table(file, col.names = c("sequence", "reads"), comment.char = "", quote = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        mutate(table, host = host, library = library)
      })
    })
    if (nrow(chromosome_counts) > 0) {
      write_tsv(chromosome_counts, file.path(ctx$tables, "host_reads_per_sequence.tsv"))
      para("The reads per host sequence are in `Rreports/preprocess/tables/host_reads_per_sequence.tsv`, and they can show which ",
           "part of a host genome attracts the reads.")
    }
  }
})
```

```{r fastqc}
section("Quality checks after each step (FastQC)", {
  stage_files <- bind_rows(
    tibble(stage = "Raw", folder = p("results", "reads")),
    tibble(stage = "After fastp", folder = fastp_dir),
    map_dfr(host_names, ~ tibble(stage = paste0("After ", .x), folder = p("results", "preprocess", "bowtie2", paste0("non", .x))))
  )
  status <- pmap_dfr(stage_files, function(stage, folder) {
    zips <- file.path(folder, paste0(rep(libraries(), each = 2), "_", 1:2, "_fastqc.zip"))
    map_dfr(zips[file.exists(zips)], ~ mutate(read_fastqc(.x)$status, stage = stage, file = basename(.x)))
  })
  if (nrow(status) == 0) {
    no_output("FastQC", "results/preprocess/")
  } else {
    table <- status %>%
      count(module, stage, status) %>%
      group_by(module, stage) %>%
      summarise(result = paste0(n, " ", status, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = stage, values_from = result)
    table <- table[match(unique(status$module), table$module), c("module", intersect(stage_files$stage, names(table)))]
    show_table(rename(table, Check = module), "Results of FastQC's checks after each step, in numbers of files", "fastqc_per_step", max_rows = 20)
    write_tsv(status, file.path(ctx$tables, "fastqc_status.tsv"))
    fastqc_notes()
  }
})
```

```{r methods}
section("Methods text", {
  para("You can use or adapt this text for a paper. It describes what the rules of this module did.")
  settings <- ctx$params$preprocess$fastp
  para(
    "> Adapters and low-quality bases were removed with ", tv("fastp"), ", using the adapter sequences of the sample sheet, a minimum read length of ",
    settings$length_required %||% "?", " bp and the options `", trimws(settings$extra %||% ""), "`.",
    if (length(host_names) > 0) {
      paste0(" Host reads were removed by mapping the read pairs with ", tv("Bowtie2"), " to ",
             paste(host_names, collapse = ", "), ", one after the other, and keeping pairs with both reads unmapped, with ", tv("SAMtools"), ".")
    } else {
      ""
    },
    " The result of each step was checked with ", tv("FastQC"), "."
  )
  if (length(fastp) > 0) {
    para("fastp ran on the first library with this command:")
    cat("\n\n```\n", paste(strwrap(fastp[[1]]$command, width = 90, exdent = 4), collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
  }
})
```
